violationCategoryName: Time and Temperature for Food Safety (F = degrees Fahrenheit)
inspectorNotes: Observed raw fish stored in bucket of water at 64F for less than 4 hours. COS

violationItemText: Food and ice obtained from approved source; Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated; parasite destruction
inspectorNotes: Observed mold like substance on upper interior of ice machine.

violationItemText: Food Separated & protected, prevented during food preparation, storage, display, and tasting
inspectorNotes: Observed raw shelled eggs stored above RTE foods in walk in cooler and reach in cooler in server area. COS

violationItemText: Food contact surfaces and Returnables ; Cleaned and Sanitized at _______ ppm/temperature
inspectorNotes: Observed sheet pans and utensils with food debris on them, stored on clean ware rack. COS recleaned

violationItemText: Hands cleaned and properly washed/ Gloves used properly
inspectorNotes: Observed employee blow their nose, then start food prep without washing his hands. COS, I spoke with employee and they washed their hands.

violationItemText: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used
inspectorNotes: Observed a spray bottle on prep table in kitchen holding blue liquid not labeled for contents. COS

violationItemText: Approved Sewage/Wastewater Disposal System, proper disposal
inspectorNotes: Observed employee dump mop bucket just outside kitchen back door, and accumulation of grease around grease container behind establishment, and under stove and fryers in kitchen.

violationItemText: Compliance with Variance, Specialized Process, and HACCP plan; Variance obtained for specialized processing methods; manufacturer instructions
inspectorNotes: Observed equipment used for reduced oxygen packaging without having an approved HACCP plan.

violationItemText: Adequate handwashing facilities: Accessible and properly supplied, used
inspectorNotes: Observed no hand washing cleanser or hand dry provision at hand wash sink behind new bar.

violationItemText: No Evidence of Insect contamination, rodent/other animals
inspectorNotes: Observed kitchen back door does not fully self close.

violationItemText: Personal Cleanliness/eating, drinking or tobacco use
inspectorNotes: Observed employees with facial hair preparing food without donning a beard net.

Observed fish in walk in cooler in ROP labeled that it is to be kept frozen until time of use shall be removed from the reduced oxygen environment prior to its thawing under refrigeration. COS voluntarily discarded.

violationItemText: Utensils, equipment, & linens; properly used, stored, dried, & handled/ In use utensils; properly used
inspectorNotes: Observed pans stacked before dry on clean ware rack. (nesting)
Observed heavy accumulation of grease on top of drawer cooler located under stove.

violationItemText: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
inspectorNotes: Observed accumulation of dust on vent cover in kitchen.

violationItemText: Garbage and Refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
inspectorNotes: Observed lid left open on grease container behind establishment.

violationItemText: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
inspectorNotes: Observed heavy grease/dust/dirt accumulation on kitchen floor throughout the kitchen. Imminent fire hazard. Observed bare wood under new bar not sealed.
Observed no certified food manager certification posted and no hand wash sink posted at hand wash sink under bar.
